forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE. (1) VP Vance Sep 4: ‘no talks with Tehran until it stops shooting at commercial shipping’ — explicit US-side rejection of any near-term session; (2) Iran launched 59 missiles/drones Sep 2 and additional strikes Sep 3 on Kuwait and UAE; (3) Pezeshkian’s SCO conditional offer (Sep 1) was rebuffed within hours by the strike-retaliation cycle; (4) Qatar PM and Oman FM visits to Tehran Aug 27 produced no scheduled session; Trump waved off deal idea Sep 2. Qatar/Pakistan relay channels remain open but no session date exists. Base rate for a diplomatic session within 12 days of heavy bilateral military exchange: very low. Small residual for Oman back-channel — see DA opposing narrative.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of ‘semi-negotiating’ without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach ≥30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE. (1) IRGC spokesman Zolfaghari officially confirmed Sep 3 that Iranian forces deployed additional Maham-3 and Maham-7 naval mines along southern transit channels — voiding the Aug 27 CENTCOM ‘mine-free’ declaration; (2) Two commercial tankers struck mines Sep 2-3; (3) AIS-tracked transits: 11 (Sep 2), 9 (Sep 3), 4 (Sep 4); 10-day rolling average approximately 13-15 vessels; (4) To reach ≥30 vessels/day 7-day avg by Oct 3, traffic must more than double from already-low levels against active mining. Near-certain NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any AIS-based ship-tracking source (IMF PortWatch, Straits.live, MarineTraffic, Lloyd’s List Intelligence) records ≥30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: AIS-based tracker + one TIER1 or OSINT confirmation (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd’s List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit; if trackers diverge by >20%, flag AMBIGUOUS. Convoy operations under naval escort count only if civilian commercial operators are conducting them voluntarily.

forecasts.question: Will US and Iran announce or observe a mutual cessation of offensive operations before EOD 2026-11-30?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast. June MOU collapsed July; Sep 1-3 escalation cycle. Historical pattern: ceasefire attempts every 6-8 weeks (April 8, June 17). 86-day window captures two full diplomatic cycles plus the post-October-27-Israeli-election window. Pezeshkian’s conditional Sep 1 MOU offer keeps the MOU channel theoretically alive. Calibrated at 0.25 for the 86-day horizon, consistent with historical cycle rate.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a formal ceasefire agreement, announced mutual pause in offensive operations, or announced return to a prior MOU framework is confirmed by ≥2 independent TIER1 sources, with both US and Iranian officials publicly acknowledging it, before EOD 2026-11-30.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera/Bloomberg) OR one TIER1 + named official government statement from both sides.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unilateral ceasefire (US stops but Iran does not acknowledge, or vice versa) = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Conditional ceasefire offers without formal joint announcement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. A 24h pause that collapses immediately = AMBIGUOUS.
